spans.s:
दैन 1. दैन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. दिन), relating
to a day, diurnal, daily.

दैन 2. दैन or दैन्य, अम्, n. (fr. दीन),
wretchedness, feebleness, weakness, affliction, sorrow,
grief, depression, low-spiritedness; poverty, humble-
ness, a poor and pitiable state, miserable state; mean-
ness, covetousness.

दैनन्दिन, अस्, ई, अम्, happening daily, diurnal,
quotidian.
—दैनन्दिन-प्रलय, अस्, n. destruc-
tion of the world after the lapse of fifteen years of
Brahmā's age.

दैनिक, अस्, ई, अम्, diurnal, relating daily to a
day; (ई), f. a day's hire or wages.

दैनार दैनार, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. दीनार), bought
with a Dīnār, of the value of a Dīnār.
